## Problem

What are you trying to do that probe does not support today?

## Proposal

The verb / protocol / backend you have in mind, and how it fits the existing model (same
verbs, swap the backend).

## Scope

- [ ] This stays in the stdlib-only core, or
- [ ] It needs a real-hardware dependency (which belongs behind an optional extra, not the
      core).

## Alternatives

Other tools or approaches you considered.
